primary_diagnosis_treated: Metabolic syndrome (components: hypertension, obesity, dyslipidaemia, pre‑diabetes, obstructive sleep apnoea)

medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 recommends ACE‑I as first‑line therapy for hypertension

medications.purpose: Primary prevention of cardiovascular disease in metabolic syndrome
medications.nice_justification: NICE CG181 advises a statin for QRISK ≥10 % or metabolic‑syndrome components

medications.purpose: Add‑on antihypertensive to achieve target <140/90 mmHg
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 recommends a CCB as second‑line when BP remains uncontrolled on ACE‑I

medications.dose: 500 mg PO daily with evening meal, titrate by 500 mg weekly to 1500 mg daily (500 mg TID) as tolerated
medications.duration: Lifelong — review annually (initiate after confirming eGFR ≥30 mL/min/1.73 m²)
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG28 recommends metformin as first‑line for type 2 diabetes and high‑risk pre‑diabetes

medications.dose: 0.25 mg subcutaneous weekly for 4 weeks, then increase to 0.5 mg weekly (can titrate to 1 mg if needed)
medications.duration: Lifelong — review annually (initiate after confirming BMI ≥30 kg/m² and no contraindications)
medications.purpose: Weight reduction and additional cardiovascular risk reduction
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG28 recommends GLP‑1 RA for obesity with cardiovascular risk

interactions_checked.interaction: No clinically significant pharmacokinetic or pharmacodynamic interaction

interactions_checked.action: Monitor blood pressure after initiation and titration

contraindications.reason: eGFR not yet measured; NICE NG28 contraindicates metformin if eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m²
contraindications.alternative: Obtain serum creatinine/eGFR and start only if ≥30

contraindications.reason: Family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma / MEN2 not documented; contraindicated per NICE NG28
contraindications.alternative: Take detailed family history before prescribing

assumptions_warnings: QRISK score not available – required to confirm statin indication per NICE CG181.
eGFR, serum creatinine, and electrolytes not available – needed for metformin safety and ACE‑I monitoring.
Liver function tests not available – required before starting atorvastatin.
HbA1c / fasting glucose not available – needed to confirm pre‑diabetes/diabetes before metformin or GLP‑1 RA.
Exact BMI and waist circumference not recorded – needed for obesity management decisions.
Obstructive sleep apnoea severity (AHI) not documented – CPAP referral pending.
Allergy history not documented – must verify no hypersensitivity to proposed drugs.
Family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma / MEN2 not documented – required before GLP‑1 RA.
treatment_summary: The patient with metabolic syndrome should continue lisinopril, start atorvastatin 20 mg nightly for primary CVD prevention, add amlodipine 5 mg daily if blood pressure remains above target, and consider metformin and semaglutide after confirming renal function, liver enzymes, BMI, and relevant family history. Monitoring includes BP, lipid profile (3 months then annually), HbA1c (6 monthly if pre‑diabetes), eGFR and electrolytes (baseline and 1‑month), and liver function before statin. Lifestyle advice (diet, exercise, weight loss, smoking cessation) and CPAP for OSA are also recommended.
